# Authored JPEG XL mask fixture

`lossy-edges.jxl` is a 64 × 64 grayscale image generated by `generate.py` using
libjxl `cjxl` 0.12.0 (VarDCT, distance 1, effort 3, one thread). It contains a
white half-plane and circle on black. All fixture content and the generator are
original RapidRoom test data, dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0.
No Lightroom file, Adobe asset, photograph or metadata is included.

Its finite decoded float samples cross the nominal 0–1 range near edges.
The importer must clamp those samples during 8-bit coverage quantization while
continuing to reject NaN and infinities. Run the generator only when explicitly
regenerating this fixture; tests use the committed bytes.
